items.text: Added new structures (ferry terminal, outpost, oil rig, gas station, radtown, supermarket, water well, apartment complex, floating city) to the building menu.
Fixed raw beef not converting to cooked beef when cooked.
Added new meat types to all oven prefabs, expanding cooking options.
Fixed issue where multiple animals near a vehicle would not function correctly.
Fixed missing close button on the map UI.
Players can now mount Gen2 AI entities via the new NPCMountable component, enabling direct parenting without frame‑by‑frame repositioning; mounting currently teleports the player.

2026-09-14.summary:
### Building & Structures
- Added new structures (ferry terminal, outpost, oil rig, gas station, radtown, supermarket, water well, apartment complex, floating city) to the building menu.

### Cooking & Food
- Fixed raw beef not converting to cooked beef when cooked.
- Added new meat types to all oven prefabs, expanding cooking options.

### Animals & AI
- Fixed issue where multiple animals near a vehicle would not function correctly.

### UI
- Fixed missing close button on the map UI.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Players can now mount Gen2 AI entities via the new NPCMountable component, enabling direct parenting without frame‑by‑frame repositioning; mounting currently teleports the player.

items.text: Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.
Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.
Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.
Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.

2026-09-13.summary:
### Animals & Resources
- Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.

### Weapons
- Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.

### Bug Fixes
- Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.
